WORKING:
- Overlay window: 90px wide (was 140px), 28px idle / 36px on hover
- Idle pill: 12px height, dark glass background rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 100px radius, 2.5px wide bars, borderRadius 4px
- Active pill: 18px height, unchanged animation
